name: To Provide Interest Subvention to Animal Husbandry of the State at the Rate of 4% to the Beneficiaries Kisan Credit Card
benefit: **Name of Component** **Standard of Assistance** **Minimum Time Limit (in Year) for Reclaiming Benefits)**To provide interest subvention to animal husbandry of the state at the rate of 4% to the beneficiaries Kishan Credit Card.4% interest subvention on timely repayment of short-term loan taken by animal husbandry up to ₹2,00,000/-. only once in a financial year
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a cattle breeder.
1. The applicant must have taken a short-term loan from any of the following during the financial year:

  - Primary Agricultural Credit Cooperative Society
  - District Central Cooperative Bank
  - Nationalized Bank
  - Gramin Bank
  - Private Bank

1. The applicant must have repaid the loan on time.
